targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('15 minute', r.time) AS time,
  r.meter_id,
  AVG(r.power_kw) AS value
FROM realtime_electricity r
JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = r.meter_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.time)
  AND m.meter_type = 'electricity'
  AND m.is_main = true
GROUP BY time_bucket('15 minute', r.time), r.meter_id
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  COALESCE(SUM(meter_kwh), 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.meter_id,
    GREATEST(MAX(a.total_kwh) - MIN(a.total_kwh), 0) AS meter_kwh
  FROM accumulator_electricity a
  JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = a.meter_id
  WHERE m.meter_type = 'electricity'
    AND m.is_main = true
    AND a.time >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
  GROUP BY a.meter_id
) per_meter;

SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  COALESCE(SUM(meter_kwh), 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.meter_id,
    GREATEST(MAX(a.total_kwh) - MIN(a.total_kwh), 0) AS meter_kwh
  FROM accumulator_electricity a
  JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = a.meter_id
  WHERE m.meter_type = 'electricity'
    AND m.is_main = true
    AND a.time >= date_trunc('month', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
  GROUP BY a.meter_id
) per_meter;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('15 minute', time) AS time,
  AVG(flow_rate_kgh) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'S-DYE1') AS "S-DYE1",
  AVG(flow_rate_kgh) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'S-BOIL') AS "S-BOIL",
  AVG(flow_rate_kgh) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'S-DYE2') AS "S-DYE2"
FROM realtime_steam
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.meter_id)
  r.meter_id,
  r.flow_rate_kgh,
  r.pressure_bar,
  r.temperature_c,
  r.time
FROM realtime_steam r
JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = r.meter_id
WHERE m.meter_type = 'steam'
ORDER BY r.meter_id, r.time DESC;

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', r.time) AS time,
  m.description,
  AVG(r.total_m3) AS total_m3
FROM
  accumulator_water r
  JOIN meters m USING (meter_id)
WHERE
  r.meter_id NOT LIKE '%IN%'
  AND r.time >= date_trunc('year', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
  AND r.time < NOW()
GROUP BY
  time_bucket('1 minute', r.time),
  m.description
ORDER BY
  time asc;

SELECT time, description, value FROM (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('1 day', r.time) AS time,
    m.description,
    AVG(r.total_m3) AS value
  FROM accumulator_water r
  JOIN meters m USING (meter_id)
  WHERE  m.is_main = FALSE
    AND '$meterType' = 'water'
    AND r.time >= date_trunc('year', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
    AND r.time < NOW()
  GROUP BY time_bucket('1 day', r.time), m.description

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    time_bucket('1 day', r.time) AS time,
    m.description,
    AVG(r.total_kwh) AS value
  FROM accumulator_electricity r
  JOIN meters m USING (meter_id)
  WHERE m.is_main = FALSE
    AND '$meterType' = 'electricity'
    AND r.time >= date_trunc('year', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
    AND r.time < NOW()
  GROUP BY time_bucket('1 day', r.time), m.description
) sub
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', r.time) AS time,

  AND r.time <  date_trunc('month', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')

ORDER BY time asc;
